question: In the original further-reaching meetings, does one shared distinction bind independent side distinctions jointly? Can an equally far-reaching take make these meetings without maximizing holders?
population: All 205 archived positive start/ration/treatment configurations, from all four source files. Use all distinct marked split rounds in the archived rows per configuration, seven attempted rounds. The baseline replays unbarred actual growth under each knot law. At every marked split grow both descents and recover all original, wholly-apart part pairs that first meet, including cases without a third second part and records with only one-sided witnesses. This covers the actual first meetings used in the historical four-run tests as a superset; it does not rerun the interventions or test place versus form.
order: Interleave the four source lists, stable archived line order within list. Restrictions by affordability use a predeclared leading prefix only, with an explicit note and time estimate before the run. No selecting by outcome.

selection.MOST: Only the unique maximum number of holders among C2.
selection.RECENT: Take the sole candidate if C2 has one. Otherwise take iff exactly one C2 candidate was taken as an extra by any birth in the immediately preceding completed round; no marks at the start. Ties abstain.
selection.OUTER: Take the sole candidate if C2 has one. Otherwise take iff C2 minus C1 contains precisely one distinction. C1 and C2 each intersect the parents’ eligible knot sets before reading their shared distinctions. Ties abstain.

first_meeting: First recognized group, demand group, or actual take crossing different parts wholly apart at the split, as defined by the source. Use the actual roster at that phase; endpoints pure with respect to this pair, third descent allowed. For met or demand, a third knot w witnesses both u,v. One actual candidate c must be shared by all three. In a cross take c must be taken by the actual newborn and held by the opposing pre-round supplier. Record split arms, missing pure pair, link origin (made/start-held), and cross-take vs common witness separately. Shared variables of either side alone are not automatically shared by both.
relation: At the end of the first meeting round t project the conjunction of ALL actual even-parity or not-all-equal knot rules onto (a,b,c), for every a in places(u) minus places(v) and b in places(v) minus places(u), including barred and loose variables. No conditioning. c is an identical physical distinction on both sides. Bit index 4a+2b+c. Mark prior existence of a,b and their four-bit pre-meeting projection if both exist. Literal projections are exhaustive for this reading; full-record native recurrence needs independent witnessing.
classification: Exact 8-state tables: full, constrained K1–K3 knot, proper hub if equal to ac⋈bc with both binary arms informative, one-sided factorization, other constrained (including an ab tie), empty. Retain exact three pair projections and canonical knotlab CLI results. A constant or non-open side or constant c must be tagged. A bridge with different distinctions and no single identity does not furnish such a triple. A shared witness alone is an incidence classification.
predictions: MOST reproduces the archive strata with both a wholly made link and a start-held link in not-all-equal. Recompute parity independently. Hypothesis for literal triples: no constrained irreducible three-place relation; report the first exception. Disposition is observed exact truth tables, even when this hypothesis fails. No exclusion of hubs by definition or classification of all free triples as proper hubs.

At least one prespecified non-ranking take makes a genuinely further-reaching choice (c outside C1) and produces a first meeting of previously separate descents linked only through made knots, with a declared strict form requiring no start-holder on the linking distinction. Check both statistical populations and stronger criteria separately. Record whether the further-reaching take served that same meeting directly or only occurred elsewhere in its trajectory; no inferred causal dependence on a different birth. Compare MOST and SOLE on identical starts. No inference about all possible rules.
extra_reading: For MOST take the first occurrence of each actual shared candidate in lexicographic physical order (s,t,ordered side parts,w,u,v,c), one representative per case, route type and start-held vs made origin per knot law. For each selected representative with total width <=14 project both full sets of exclusive endpoint places and c; test conditional factorization by joining its Ac and Bc projections; preserve both joint and arm sizes and any missing combination. If the first exceeds width, report not run without substitution. This same finite conditional-product test bounds all c-free functions on the respective exclusive places. It does not cover other representatives or synthetic loop patterns.
resources: First time actual formulas/configuration with stated parts per producer and replay. Four or fewer memory-capped workers per job, case timeout and original 1500-knot bound, seven rounds, one-hour target for each batch. If exact estimate exceeds about an hour, cut to registered prefix before run, with no negative for unrun cases. Use memoized distinct stages/triples with exact occurrence counts. Prioritize full MOST relation pass, other rules compare actual reach; no projection claim on any optional alternates not run.
independence: Independent Sol program reconstructs selection and actual first meetings and projected masks from raw growth supports/state under its own take; common immutable growth primitives disclosed. Growth producer and separate projection program; the root verifies representative full-arm relations using separate methods. Each result requires second program agreement.
